pr.title: Green add-to-cart CTA with confirmation toast
pr.body_author:
Closes SHOP-412

## Test plan
- open Products, tap first product, tap 'Add to cart', see toast and badge

tickets.title: Green add-to-cart CTA with confirmation toast
tickets.description_md: The user must get a clear confirmation that a product was added to the cart.

acceptance_criteria.text: The 'Add to cart' button on the product screen is green (a shade close to #1DB954), not blue
After tapping 'Add to cart' a toast with the text 'Added: <product name>' appears and disappears after about 3 seconds
The cart counter in the header increases by 1 after adding a product

repo_knowledge.playbook_md:
# Acme Shop (web)
- Bottom tabs: Home, Products, Cart, Profile.
- The product 'Orchid Mantis' (62 PLN) is always first in the Products list.
- Cart counter: element with testID cart-badge in the header.
- Do not touch: Profile -> 'Delete account'.
